long_biography.plain_text:
Before founding Series Seating, Mauricio Olarte studied industrial design in New York and taught in Mexico and Colombia. He became dean of design at Bogotá’s Jorge Tadeo Lozano University, then bought a small furniture company. That purchase grew into a specialist seating business whose headquarters later moved to Miami, while its manufacturing base remained in Colombia and expanded to North Carolina.

Olarte has continued to design products himself rather than serve solely as an executive. For the Winspear Opera House in Dallas, his team developed customised seating in collaboration with architects and theatre consultants, solving acoustic, access and installation challenges. The same combination of engineering and ergonomics shapes the company’s work for arenas, cinemas and schools.
